senses.gloss: m. (cmp. הוּץ II a. הוּצָא), only in pl. constr. הוֹצְנֵי פשתן (hard) flax-stalks before they are prepared for spinning, opp. אֲנִיצֵי, v. אָנִיץ.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:5">Tosef. Succ. I, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 12b:6">Succ. 12ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 52ᵇ bot. V. <cite ref="E00286"><he>הוֹשֶׁן</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:8">Tosef. Maasr. III, 8</cite> <he>ה׳ פשתן</he> (Var. <he>אוצני</he>) read: <he>ה׳ תלתן</he> stalks of fenugrec.
